name: anime
premise: Interior conviction is external and loud; what a person decides about themselves changes what they can do.
obligatory_beats: a stated principle the protagonist will be forced to test
a moment of resolve articulated aloud or in direct interior address
an opponent whose position is comprehensible and nearly sympathetic
pacing_curve: Held stillness, then sudden expansion. Slow the frame right before a decision; let the decision itself take a full paragraph.
sensory_palette: weather as emotional weather — rain at the turn, wind before a choice
food shared as a way of saying something else
the physical detail of a familiar place seen for the last time
hands, shoulders, the set of a jaw
pov_distance: Close third with declared interiority. Thought is permitted to be direct and unironic.
dialogue_register: Earnest and declarative. Characters name their values out loud. Formality marks relationships; a dropped honorific is an event.
taboo_moves: power described in numbers rather than in cost
an antagonist with no position of their own
a resolve speech that the following scene does not make expensive
